title: 座りのシーンで飽きさせないために、Seedance 2.5のプロンプトにローアングル／真上アングル／魚眼／クローズアップなど具体的なカメラワーク指定を入れて画を…
content:
座りのシーンで飽きさせないために、Seedance 2.5のプロンプトにローアングル／真上アングル／魚眼／クローズアップなど具体的なカメラワーク指定を入れて画を変える  
Cut 1はLow-angle push-in＋前景の手を強調する指定で奥行きと動きを作る  
Cut 2はCentered overhead top shot＋subtle push-inで俯瞰の変化をつける  
Cut 3はClose fisheye frontal shot＋slight forward driftで歪みと前進感を出す  
Cut 4はExtreme facial close-up＋minimal creeping push-inで表情の圧を強める

en.content:
To keep seated scenes from feeling monotonous, vary the visuals by adding specific camera work instructions to the Seedance 2.5 prompt, such as low-angle, overhead, fisheye, and close-up shots.

Cut 1 uses a Low-angle push-in + emphasis on the hand in the foreground to create depth and motion.

Cut 2 uses a Centered overhead top shot + subtle push-in to add variation from a bird’s-eye perspective.

Cut 3 uses a Close fisheye frontal shot + slight forward drift to create distortion and a sense of moving forward.

Cut 4 uses an Extreme facial close-up + minimal creeping push-in to intensify the emotional impact of the expression.
